gameDescriptionHtml:
Created by an indie team of two people, DREAMERS is inspired by the stories and games of our childhood with slow-paced narration grounded in good moral values. The graphic style is a colourful low-poly 3D, bringing a unique and nostalgic look to the game and calling you to spend your time in the exploration of its diverse regions. Designed to be played with a gamepad, DREAMERS delivers a cozy, family-friendly experience. Brew yourself a cup of hot chocolate and immerse in the about 15-hour-long storytelling, rich of cutscenes and dialogues.

Game Features

  • EXPLORE – Since its earliest prototype in 2007-2008, DREAMERS has been all about traveling, about the patience and curiosity required for new discoveries, and about the encounters that await you along the way. Join the three protagonists – the Boy, the Girl, and the Robot – and be ready to walk a lot and talk a lot with the numerous NPCs inhabiting the colorful world. Some of them may involve you in the fetch quests, while others will touch your heart or amuse you with their tales. DREAMERS is a game that celebrates friendship and the connections we form throughout our life journey, the choices that we face, and the consequences that arise from them.
  • SINGLE PLAYER CO-OP – Several levels of DREAMERS are designed as a complex labyrinth full of ambiental puzzles solved on a split-screen by two characters, controlled by a single gamepad. This collaboration serves as a metaphor for their growing friendship. We invite you to experience these moments by sharing your controller and your hot chocolate while playing comfortably on your sofa with a friend.
  • PUZZLES AND MINI-GAMES – In addition to fetch quests and stories, DREAMERS offers a variety of puzzles, challenges, and minigames that are enjoyable even for those who may feel less experienced with a controller. Activities range from fishing and taking photos, to a memory card game, resort tycoon, and an entire infrastructure of drone races and upgrades. These diverse and, accessible side quests enrich the main storyline and provide a delightful break from your explorative adventures.
  • NO VIOLENCE – We strongly believe that violence is never the solution. That’s why DREAMERS is a peaceful, non-violent adventure for players of all ages. DREAMERS is not an action game, but a relaxing and peaceful experience immersing you in its calm and slow storytelling that gently unfolds over time. Play solo, or share the journey with loved ones.
